supplements.title: Galangin modulates the NRF2/PPAR-Γ pathway, attenuating sepsis-induced tissue damage in the lungs.
supplements.summary: Galangin, a plant flavonoid, reduces lung damage in sepsis by activating protective pathways and decreasing inflammation and oxidative stress.

supplements.title: Yellow tea extract ameliorates dexamethasone-induced hepatic steatosis by modulating the gut-liver axis and reshaping microbial metabolites: a multi-omics insight.
supplements.summary: Yellow tea extract protects the liver from steroid-induced fat accumulation by boosting antioxidants and reshaping beneficial gut bacteria.

supplements.title: Multiplex gene editing enables the multibiofortification of essential vitamins and other health-promoting phytonutrients in tomato.
supplements.summary: Scientists used gene editing to create tomatoes enriched with seven health-promoting nutrients that inhibited colorectal cancer cell growth in mice.

supplements.title: In silico and in vitro analysis: Unveiling the therapeutic potential of flavonoids against KLF7 in ovarian cancer.
supplements.summary: Flavonoids show promise as a potential treatment for ovarian cancer by targeting the KLF7 protein.

supplements.title: First evidence for isolation and characterization of Bacopa monnieri (L.) Wettst-derived nanovesicles with anti-neuroblastoma potential.
supplements.summary: Plant-derived nanovesicles from Bacopa monnieri effectively suppress neuroblastoma cell growth through free radical scavenging.

supplements.title: Nuclear OXCT1 attenuates histone β-hydroxybutyrylation-mediated MHC-I transcription.
supplements.summary: Nuclear OXCT1 suppresses immune genes in hepatocellular carcinoma, reducing immunotherapy effectiveness; blocking this pathway with ketogenic diet restores treatment response.

supplements.title: Gut microbial metabolites for potentiating cancer therapy.
supplements.summary: Boosting beneficial gut bacteria metabolites through prebiotics and probiotics may enhance cancer treatment effectiveness across multiple cancer types.

supplements.title: Gut microbiota and cancer immunotherapy: from dysbiosis to personalized immune checkpoint blockade optimization.
supplements.summary: Modifying gut bacteria through transplants or diet can improve cancer immunotherapy response by enhancing the immune system's tumor-fighting ability.

supplements.title: Modulation of brain antioxidant defense, inflammation, and SIRT1 activity by a sunflower oil-based high-fat diet: protective role of L-arginine in rats.
supplements.summary: L-arginine protects rat brains from oxidative stress and inflammation caused by high-fat sunflower oil diets by boosting SIRT1 activity.

supplements.title: Chemopreventive potential of quinones: Molecular targets and therapeutic potential.
supplements.summary: Plant-based quinone compounds show promise for cancer prevention and treatment through their antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cancer-fighting properties.

supplements.title: Berberine impedes the DNA damage repair to inhibit colorectal cancer by regulating the SOX17/TCF4/PIM3 axis.
supplements.summary: Berberine stops colorectal cancer cells from repairing DNA damage through the SOX17/TCF4/PIM3 pathway, slowing tumor growth.

supplements.title: Very low-carbohydrate ketogenic diet in treatment-naïve women with endometrial cancer and overweight: a randomized feasibility study.
supplements.summary: A low-carbohydrate diet is feasible and well-tolerated in overweight women with endometrial cancer, boosting immune T-cells in tumors.

supplements.title: The Potential Protective Effects of Resveratrol Against Cabazitaxel-Induced Oxidative Stress and Cardiotoxicity in Rats.
supplements.summary: Resveratrol partially protects rat hearts from damage caused by cabazitaxel, a prostate cancer drug, by reducing oxidative stress.

supplements.title: Mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation inhibition by 9α,11α-dihydroxy-kaurenoic acid promotes ROS-associated apoptosis and suppresses cancer stemness in non-small cell lung cancer.
supplements.summary: A natural plant compound kills lung cancer cells by damaging mitochondria and reducing cancer stem cell properties.

supplements.title: Melatonin Alleviates Atrazine-Induced Kidney Damage by Regulating RIPK3 to Inhibit Necroptosis.
supplements.summary: Melatonin protects kidney cells from herbicide damage by blocking a cell death pathway controlled by the RIPK3 protein.

off_label.title: Development of metformin-encapsulated poly(lactic-co-glycolic acid)-polyethylene glycol nanoparticles.
off_label.summary: Researchers developed nanoparticles carrying metformin to treat thyroid cancer with potentially fewer side effects than conventional therapies.

off_label.title: Bilateral temporal arteritis with multiorgan eosinophilic infiltration treated with IL-5 targeted antibody.
off_label.summary: IL-5 antibody treatment achieved sustained remission in a patient with rare eosinophilic temporal arteritis resistant to steroids and methotrexate.

off_label.title: Exploring Synergistic Potential of Sorafenib and Atorvastatin to Launch Apoptosis and Ferroptosis-driven Mixed Cell Death Mechanism in Colorectal Cancer.
off_label.summary: Combining sorafenib and atorvastatin triggers dual cell death in colorectal cancer cells, achieving 80% tumor reduction but requiring safer delivery methods.

off_label.title: Syrosingopine enhances immune checkpoint blockade efficacy by inhibition of MCTs and metabolic reprogramming in triple-negative breast cancer.
off_label.summary: Syrosingopine, a drug that blocks lactate transporters, enhances immune therapy effectiveness in triple-negative breast cancer by reducing tumor immunosuppression.

off_label.title: Dual targeting of glutamine metabolism and lysosomal function in eliminating drug-tolerant KRAS-mutant cancer cells.
off_label.summary: Combining glutamine and lysosome inhibitors eliminates drug-resistant KRAS-mutant pancreatic and lung cancer cells that survive initial treatment.

off_label.title: A systematic review of pregnancy outcomes and management in polycystic ovary syndrome.
off_label.summary: PCOS significantly increases pregnancy complications including miscarriage, gestational diabetes, and pre-eclampsia; personalized care with letrozole and metformin improves outcomes.

off_label.title: Evaluation of the Efficacy of Combined Treatment of Liver Cancer With Losartan and Ultrasound‑Stimulated Microbubble Cavitation.
off_label.summary: Combining losartan with ultrasound-stimulated microbubbles shows promise as a new treatment approach for liver cancer.

off_label.title: Farnesylation-driven KRAS phase separation promotes colon tumor growth.
off_label.summary: KRAS protein clumping drives colon cancer growth; statin drugs can disrupt this process and slow tumors.

off_label.title: Integrated Bioinformatics and Structural Assessment Suggest Doxycycline as a Potential Candidate Targeting MMP7 in Lung Cancer and SSc-Associated ILD.
off_label.summary: Doxycycline may target MMP7 protein to treat lung cancer and a lung disease associated with systemic sclerosis.

off_label.title: Breaking bone-associated tumor vicious cycle through macrophage membrane-camouflaged nanodecoys for sonodynamic/epigenetic therapeutics of oral squamous cell carcinoma.
off_label.summary: Researchers developed a nanoparticle wrapped in immune cell membranes to treat oral cancer and prevent jaw bone invasion using two repurposed drugs.

off_label.title: Guidance on JAK inhibitor treatment for inborn errors of JAK-STAT signaling (2026). An international consensus statement on behalf of the ESID/EBMT-IEWP and ERN-RITA.
off_label.summary: JAK inhibitors show promise for treating rare immune disorders caused by JAK-STAT pathway problems, but treatment guidelines are needed.

off_label.title: Angiotensin inhibitors during neoadjuvant chemotherapy improve esophageal squamous cell carcinoma outcomes.
off_label.summary: Adding angiotensin inhibitors to chemotherapy improves treatment outcomes for esophageal squamous cell carcinoma patients.

off_label.title: Histone quality control by prokaryotic ClpP/ClpR regulates the eukaryotic mitotic cell cycle in malaria parasites
off_label.summary: Blocking fatty acid import triggers histone degradation in malaria parasites and cancer cells, preventing cell division through a bacterial-like protein-cutting mechanism.

off_label.title: YK-4-250 mitigates gastrointestinal radiation syndrome and promotes overall survival following partial body radiation injury.
off_label.summary: YK-4-250 drug improves survival and gut function in mice exposed to lethal radiation doses by blocking harmful inflammatory signals and reducing oxidative damage.

off_label.title: AI-driven multi-omics drug repurposing nominates AZD7762 as a multitarget inhibitor of IL22RA1 and FAM221A in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.
off_label.summary: AI analysis identified AZD7762 as a promising repurposed drug targeting two key genes that drive esophageal squamous cell carcinoma growth.

biomarkers.title: Diagnostic and prognostic value of lncSPATA8-AS1 in prostate cancer and its regulatory effect on tumor progression.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified a new RNA molecule called lncSPATA8-AS1 that affects prostate cancer growth and progression.

biomarkers.title: The 'oral-gut axis' transmission of microorganisms in colorectal cancer: Insights from Peptostreptococcus' perspective.
biomarkers.summary: Oral bacteria like Peptostreptococcus travel to the gut and promote colorectal cancer growth through multiple mechanisms, offering new treatment targets.

biomarkers.title: The lncRNA ZNF295-AS1 alleviates lung squamous cell carcinoma progression by reducing miR-96-5p and inhibiting cancer cell invasiveness.
biomarkers.summary: ZNF295-AS1 reduces lung squamous cell carcinoma progression by blocking miR-96-5p, decreasing cancer cell invasiveness and improving patient outcomes.

biomarkers.title: A forward genetic screen identifies Sirtuin1 as a driver of neuroendocrine prostate cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified Sirtuin1 as a key driver of aggressive neuroendocrine prostate cancer and showed that blocking it suppresses tumor progression.

biomarkers.title: Plasma central nervous system biomarkers in heavily treatment-experienced people with HIV in the PRESTIGIO registry.
biomarkers.summary: HIV patients with drug resistance show no increased brain damage markers; age and overall health matter more than treatment resistance.

biomarkers.title: Comparative Study of Sporadic and Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor-Related Forms of Myasthenia Gravis-Myositis Overlap Syndrome.
biomarkers.summary: Immune checkpoint inhibitor cancer therapy can trigger a muscle disorder resembling sporadic myasthenia gravis-myositis overlap syndrome.

biomarkers.title: CTCF directly binds G-quadruplex structures to regulate genome topology and gene expression.
biomarkers.summary: CTCF protein binds G-quadruplex DNA structures to strengthen chromatin loops and regulate gene expression in mammalian cells.

biomarkers.title: Interaction dynamics between epithelial cysts captured by tissue rheology.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers discovered that epithelial cyst interactions are governed by physical properties of cell layers, with E-cadherin affecting fusion speed.

biomarkers.title: Lactylation of PD-L1 by a lactyltransferase HAT1 dictates its protein stability and tumor immune evasion.
biomarkers.summary: HAT1 enzyme adds lactyl groups to PD-L1 protein, stabilizing it and helping tumors evade immune attack; blocking this process enhances immunotherapy effectiveness.

biomarkers.title: Navigating high-order protein fitness landscapes via deep learning on directed evolution trajectories.
biomarkers.summary: DENet uses deep learning to predict complex protein mutations in cancer targets like KRAS and MEK1, improving drug resistance understanding.

biomarkers.title: Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) infection causes human germinal center B cell-derived lymphomas in the absence of EBNA2 expression.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers created the first model showing how EBV infects germinal center B cells and causes lymphomas without EBNA2, advancing understanding of EBV-driven cancers.

biomarkers.title: Whole-genome sequencing with AVITI and NovaSeq X Plus reveals comparable performance with contextual biases.
biomarkers.summary: AVITI and NovaSeq X Plus sequencing show comparable performance for variant detection in tumor cells, with platform-specific strengths in different genomic regions.

biomarkers.title: USP39 reduces BRCA1 methylation to promote mitochondrial biogenesis and lower drug sensitivity in ovarian cancer through deubiquitinating ZC3H18.
biomarkers.summary: USP39 stabilizes ZC3H18 to reduce BRCA1 methylation, boost mitochondrial function, and increase chemotherapy resistance in ovarian cancer.

biomarkers.title: Monocyte-derived IL-1β predicts and promotes HBsAg decline in chronic hepatitis B patients under nucleoside analogue therapy.
biomarkers.summary: A protein called IL-1β from immune cells predicts and helps achieve hepatitis B surface antigen loss in patients on antiviral therapy.

biomarkers.title: Prognostic Score for Myelodysplastic Syndromes Based on Molecular Evolution.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers created ProgEvo, a new scoring system that tracks molecular changes in myelodysplastic syndromes to better predict patient outcomes and guide treatment decisions.

trials.title: An integrative literature review to develop a conceptual framework for spiritual nursing care in pediatric oncology.
trials.summary: Spiritual support significantly affects children with cancer's emotional health and treatment outcomes, but remains inconsistently provided in pediatric oncology settings.

trials.title: Comparative Study of Sporadic and Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor-Related Forms of Myasthenia Gravis-Myositis Overlap Syndrome.
trials.summary: Immune checkpoint inhibitor cancer therapy can trigger a muscle disorder resembling sporadic myasthenia gravis-myositis overlap syndrome.

trials.title: Immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy for treatment of periocular Merkel cell carcinoma: A systematic review of clinical outcomes and safety.
trials.summary: Immune checkpoint inhibitors show promise for treating periocular Merkel cell carcinoma, with 90% of patients achieving complete response and minimal side effects.

trials.title: Monocyte-derived IL-1β predicts and promotes HBsAg decline in chronic hepatitis B patients under nucleoside analogue therapy.
trials.summary: A protein called IL-1β from immune cells predicts and helps achieve hepatitis B surface antigen loss in patients on antiviral therapy.

trials.title: Active protein-capturing hydrogel for broad-spectrum pathogen defense.
trials.summary: Researchers developed an inhalable hydrogel that traps viruses, allergens, and harmful proteins at mucosal surfaces, effectively preventing infections and allergic reactions.

trials.title: The Proposed Introduction of a Prostate Cancer Screening Program in Germany: Procedure, Necessary Studies before Implementation, Benefits, and Risks.
trials.summary: Germany proposes risk-based prostate cancer screening using PSA blood tests combined with MRI imaging to improve early detection.

trials.title: Circulating Tumor DNA in Early Breast Cancer: A Review.
trials.summary: Blood tests detecting tumor DNA could help doctors find breast cancer recurrence earlier than current methods, though more research is needed.

trials.title: Association between elemental concentrations and chemotherapy-related acute adverse events in patients with nasopharyngeal carcinoma.
trials.summary: Toxic element buildup before treatment may predict which nasopharyngeal cancer patients will experience severe chemotherapy side effects.

trials.title: RAS pathway activity subtypes identified by machine learning define prognostic and immune microenvironment characteristics in lung adenocarcinoma.
trials.summary: Machine learning identified distinct RAS pathway activity subtypes in lung adenocarcinoma that predict patient outcomes and immune responses.

trials.title: Current patterns of next-generation sequencing testing in biliary tract cancer patients in Spain.
trials.summary: Spanish hospitals vary widely in using genetic sequencing to identify targeted treatments for biliary tract cancer patients.

trials.title: Pooled survival and cost-effectiveness analysis of immune checkpoint inhibitors-based for metastatic non-small-cell lung cancer with PD-L1 lower than 1.
trials.summary: Immune checkpoint inhibitors show survival benefits and cost-effectiveness for advanced lung cancer patients with low PD-L1 levels.

trials.title: Increasing and more consistent use of pre-biopsy MRI in prostate cancer diagnosis: insights from a population-based study in the Netherlands.
trials.summary: Dutch hospitals increasingly use MRI before prostate biopsies to detect cancer, improving diagnostic consistency across the country.

trials.title: Predicting late radiation-associated neurocognitive and endocrine toxicity in patients with brain tumors.
trials.summary: Researchers identified genetic and vascular risk factors to better predict brain damage and hormone problems after brain tumor radiation treatment.

trials.title: Predictors of pathologic complete response in early-stage triple-negative breast cancer treated with neoadjuvant chemo-immunotherapy: a multi-institution study.
trials.summary: Adding pembrolizumab immunotherapy to chemotherapy improves complete tumor response rates in early-stage triple-negative breast cancer.

trials.title: Antibody-drug conjugates in colorectal cancer: molecular design, preclinical advances, and translational challenges.
trials.summary: Antibody-drug conjugates show promise for colorectal cancer by combining antibody precision with potent toxins to kill tumors selectively.
